name: near-agencies#102 at 844d54b: duplicate payout proposals, audit window
head: 844d54bd968460d8767d797cc34b5a5cd60798c0
source: Raised on this commit by Claude's review (comment 4179827318) and fixed in #139, which reads every page of proposals from the job's floor.

bugs.windowGap: Does this code review CLAIM, as a defect, that the audit reads only one page of 100 proposals starting from the job's lowest recorded proposal id (payoutFloor), so when a job's recorded proposals are far apart (more than about 75 ids) a later task's proposal or its duplicate falls outside the window and a double approval is recorded as a single payment? Saying the window is correct, or only describing it, is NO.
